draft_en.subject: Commercial PoE switches for your CCTV kits - 8 and 24 ports
draft_en.body:
Hello Tayama team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 1 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

For the commercial PoE switches you list with CCTV kits, neutral packing, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); 24 x PoE+ (280 W) + 4 x SFP, STC-424DGGPM-280W - $134.5.

One question: which PoE port count do your installer customers buy most - 4, 8 or 24?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
